summary: Celcuity Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $575M underwritten public offering of 0.250% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032. The offering included a full over-allotment exercise, generating net proceeds of ~$557M. Proceeds will repay outstanding loan obligations and fund working capital, clinical trials, commercialization, and potential acquisitions. The notes are unsecured senior obligations. Investors should watch for dilution risk from conversion and the company's use of proceeds for business development.
